title: AgentOS Policy v0
description: Declarative description of what a task needs (P1 unified policy format). One policy object compiles to any compatible sandbox backend (srt / codex-sandbox / OpenShell / Landlock / containers). Evolution rule: v0.x may add fields, never break existing ones.

workdir.description: Read-write root: the only writable directory for this task (absolute path)

extra_read.description: Read-only roots: additional directories readable but not writable

allow_commands.description: Command allowlist, matched against the basename of argv[0]

network.description: Whether the sandboxed task may make outbound network connections. Default false. Model API calls happen outside the sandbox and are not affected by this flag

max_steps.description: Model turn budget, as a run-stop guard

backend.description: Enforcement backend preference; auto degrades kernel-native > container > software. The actual level used MUST be recorded in the ledger
